copy.lede: Dan runs MosaicMe, tiling and refurbishing kitchens, bathrooms and floors around Reading. Customers say he explains things clearly, keeps the place tidy and goes above and beyond, from a small repair to two months of floor tiling.
copy.about_alt: A walk-in shower with metro tiles and a patterned floor, tiled by MosaicMe
